problem:
Given the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}-\text{i} & \text{i} \\ 7 & 3-2\text{i}\end{aligned}]$, find the result of applying to $A$ the following elementary row operations: 

$$
{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+\frac{7}{\text{i}}{R}_{1}
$$
worked_solution:
Let's apply the row operations to $A:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}-\text{i} & \text{i} \\ 7 & 3-2\text{i}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+\frac{7}{\text{i}}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-\text{i} & \text{i} \\ 7+(-\text{i})\cdot \frac{7}{\text{i}} & \text{(}3-2\text{i})+i\cdot \frac{7}{\text{i}}\end{aligned}] \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-\text{i} & \text{i} \\ 0 & 10-2\text{i}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the result  is 

$$
[\begin{aligned}-\text{i} & \text{i} \\ 0 & 10-2\text{i}\end{aligned}].
$$
